item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of moments built for pausing, and each one is a chance to drink water. Dehydration quietly drains focus and patience, which are exactly what a full day asks of you. Don't wait for thirst. It's a late signal. Steady sips beat catching up later. Your action: fill a large glass of water right now, and finish it before your next break.
